steps: Take besan in a large mixing bowl. Add salt and turmeric powder.
Gradually pour in water while whisking to make a lump-free batter. Add oil and lemon juice and mix well.
Just before steaming, add Eno to the batter and gently mix until it becomes light and fluffy.
Grease dhokla moulds with oil. Pour the batter into them, filling each mould only about three-fourths of the way. Place them in a steamer and cook for around 12-15 minutes.
Heat oil in a small pan. Add mustard seeds and let them splutter. Add curry leaves and slit green chillies. Stir briefly and turn off the heat.
Remove the steamed dhokla from the moulds and place them on a plate. Pour the prepared tempering over them so that they absorb the flavours.
Take serving bowls and spread a layer of whisked yoghurt at the bottom. Add green chutney and tamarind chutney.
Place the steamed dhokla pieces over the yoghurt and chutneys. Sprinkle chaat masala and roasted cumin powder on top.
Garnish generously with sev, pomegranate pearls, boondi and freshly chopped coriander leaves.
Prepare the bowls just before serving so that the dhokla stays soft while the sev retains its crunch. Serve immediately.

travel.title: A Diwali Ticket Home Now Costs Up to Rs 2.5 Lakh From London
travel.excerpt: Fares from the Gulf to Hyderabad are up over 400 percent as workers who skipped trips during months of regional unrest all head home for the festival at once.
travel.nri_angle: The Gulf is home to millions of Indian workers whose Diwali trip is a three-to-five-day dash home; a 400 percent fare surge decides whether many of them go at all.

travel.title: Where Niagara Residents Can Set Off Fireworks for Diwali, City by City
travel.excerpt: Niagara Falls permits Diwali fireworks November 7-11 and St. Catharines November 7-9, each with strict hours and private-property rules. Welland's bylaw does not list Diwali, and Thorold requires the Fire Chief's written approval for other holidays.
travel.nri_angle: Ontario's Niagara region has a growing South Asian community, and its Diwali fireworks rules differ sharply by municipality — Niagara Falls and St. Catharines permit them on set dates, while Welland and Thorold do not permit a Diwali display as of right.

travel.title: Ekta Nagar's Glow Garden and 1.5-Crore-Light Display Draw Diwali-Week Families
travel.excerpt: An upgraded Unity Glow Garden, a 530-metre illuminated stretch and a 180-metre Glow Tunnel anchor Ekta Prakash Parv at the Statue of Unity, while Bharat Parv runs until November 15 and the statue stays open on Monday, November 9.
travel.nri_angle: Ekta Nagar's upgraded glow garden and light festival give diaspora families visiting Gujarat for Diwali a concrete after-dark itinerary at the Statue of Unity, including a special Monday opening on November 9.

carousel.title: Haitian Third-Grader Taken Into Federal Custody After San Diego ICE Check-In
carousel.excerpt: San Diego Unified says an 8-year-old Fay Elementary student was separated from the uncle caring for him at a scheduled appointment. DHS says the man could not establish legal guardianship, so the boy was classed as an unaccompanied minor and sent to the Office of Refugee Resettlement.
carousel.nri_angle: The case shows how the end of Haiti TPS on July 27, 2026 reaches into US classrooms: a child who complied with an ICE summons was reclassified as an unaccompanied minor because his caregiver could not document legal guardianship.

carousel.title: FICCI Puts Air Pollution's Annual Cost at $95 Billion, Urges Health-Led Plan
carousel.excerpt: A FICCI-EY paper links polluted air to more than two million deaths in India in 2023 and calls for explicit PM2.5 targets, regional airshed action and year-round health planning instead of seasonal emergency responses.
carousel.image_caption: Satellite view of air pollution over northern India (NESDIS). A FICCI report put air pollution's annual cost to India at $95 billion and urged a health-led plan.
carousel.nri_angle: Pollution on this scale shapes winter travel, family health and caregiving decisions for diaspora readers with parents and children in India.

carousel.title: Swara Bhasker Hosts Qawwali Baithak at Home to Celebrate Diwali After Rise and Fall
carousel.excerpt: The actor welcomed Priyanka Chahar Choudhary, Faye D'Souza and designer Aprajita Toor for an evening of live Qawwali by Arif Naza and party, telling Filmibeat she wanted a celebration that felt intimate, warm and full of life.
carousel.nri_angle: Swara Bhasker's home Qawwali baithak is the intimate, music-first end of Diwali celebration — the kind of gathering diaspora families recreate abroad, built around live performance, food and close company rather than scale.

carousel.title: Ashwin Says Only Bumrah Is Locked In as India's 2027 World Cup Pace Race Tightens
carousel.excerpt: R Ashwin said Jasprit Bumrah is the only fast bowler certain of a 2027 ODI World Cup place, and that Mohammed Siraj, for all his experience, is not a lock given how little ODI cricket India have given him. Prasidh Krishna, Arshdeep Singh and Anshul Kamboj are all in the race, he said.
carousel.image_caption: R Ashwin tosses a ball during a training session. Ashwin said Jasprit Bumrah is the only fast bowler locked into India's squad for the 2027 ODI World Cup.
carousel.nri_angle: The 2027 World Cup runs in South Africa, Zimbabwe and Namibia in October-November 2027; which pacers India settle on decides the attack diaspora fans will watch in conditions that reward pace and bounce.
carousel.author: Diaspora Desk

carousel.title: DeepMind's AI Formally Verifies Key Signal Protocol Guarantees in Four Weeks
carousel.excerpt: Google DeepMind's AlphaProof Code produced mathematical proofs for several of the Signal protocol's core security guarantees, found no new flaws in the parts it examined, and correctly failed older versions with known bugs. The work did not cover the whole Signal app, and Google will not say what it cost.
carousel.image_caption: An illustration shows a user surrounded by digital security and shield symbols. Google DeepMind's AlphaProof Code formally verified key guarantees of the Signal protocol, which secures Signal, WhatsApp and Google Messages.
carousel.nri_angle: The Signal protocol also underpins WhatsApp, the default messaging app for most Indian diaspora families; an independent mathematical proof of its guarantees is directly relevant to the privacy of those everyday conversations.
carousel.author: Diaspora Desk

carousel.title: Ark Invest Buys $96 Million of SpaceX, Adds Nvidia and AMD, Trims Broadcom
carousel.excerpt: Cathie Wood's funds recorded $346.2 million in purchases against $305.8 million in sales last week, buying the chip sell-off and funding it mainly with a $122.2 million Broadcom sale.
carousel.image_caption: Ark Invest chief executive Cathie Wood in a television studio interview. Ark bought $96 million of SpaceX and added Nvidia and AMD shares during last week's sell-off, its daily disclosures show.

carousel.nri_angle: Ark discloses every trade daily, so diaspora investors holding ARKK can see the SpaceX position — now the fund’s largest at 7.28% — being built in the open rather than guessing at it.
